C-HOST-COMPAT-WINDOW.IntentSummary: Move host compatibility from an exact 2.0.18 patch pin to a major-bounded window with a data-driven verified list: new src/lib/host-compat.ts plus src/hosts.json become the single source, runtime discovery passes a predicate through Service.discover, the CLI reports verified/tolerated and warns once, build pins move to 2.2.5 with the matching effect and TUI peers, both live host gates accept the version under test, a drift reporter classifies upstream releases, and the update procedure is documented, with GRACE context, graph, and verification synchronized.

T-001.Title: Own the window and verified list in src/lib/host-compat.ts.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: host-compat exports MIN/MAX/RANGE, VERIFIED_HOST_VERSIONS/VERIFIED_HOST_VERSION from src/hosts.json, parseOpenCodeVersion, isSupportedOpenCodeVersion, isVerifiedOpenCodeVersion, and openCodeHostSupport.
Prereleases, 1.x, and 3.x are unsupported; 2.0.18 through 2.9.x are supported; verified versions classify as verified and other in-window versions as tolerated.
plugin-registration re-exports the same names so existing call sites and the public surface are unchanged.

T-002.Title: Make runtime discovery window-based and relocate DeepMutable.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: RuntimeDeps.serviceVersion and discoverService accept a string or predicate; nativeRuntimeDeps passes isSupportedServiceVersion.
DeepMutable is owned by runtime/types.ts because the host no longer ships @opencode/plugin/promise/types.
RuntimeUnavailableError names the supported window instead of an exact version.

T-003.Title: Report support level in the CLI and guide upgrades to the verified host.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: inspectOpenCodeRuntime returns support and verifiedHosts; status and doctor print both.
assertSupportedOpenCodeRuntime warns once on a tolerated host and still fails closed outside the window.
upgrade guidance names the window and installs the newest verified host version.

Verification.Command: bun test src/lib/opencode.test.ts src/commands/status.test.ts src/commands/doctor.test.ts src/commands/upgrade.test.ts

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: package.json declares the new exact pins and engines.opencode >=2.0.18 <3.0.0.
typecheck and the full unit/integration suite pass on the new pins without source rewrites beyond the DeepMutable relocation.
The native pin manifest gate names the same versions.

T-005.Title: Parameterize both live host gates and the probe expectations.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: PINNED_HOST_VERSION derives from VVOC_HOST_VERSION or the verified list; binary path, SHA, and source commit are overridable; both gates authorize exactly the selected version.
The probe records schemaArgumentDescriptions and hostArgNormalization, and asserts the safe invariant (reject or schema-valid normalization) instead of a host-specific forwarding shape.
The type-invalid call still must fail before execute with its exact path.
contracts:host --probe passes against 2.2.5.
bun run host:check prints the window, verified list, build pin, newest stable release and its classification, plus the next step with a nonzero exit outside verified.
host:check --download installs that exact @opencode/cli into the scratch root and prints the contracts:host environment command with the binary SHA-256.
Pure helpers are covered deterministically without network access.

T-007.Title: Document the process and synchronize GRACE projections.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: docs/host-updates.md documents the window model, patch routine, bump train, and the measured 2.2.5 observations including the partial full matrix.
README, AGENTS, and the GRACE context files describe the window and the verified list instead of the exact patch pin.
M-HOST-COMPAT and V-M-HOST-COMPAT exist in the graph and verification projections with the new module paths and commands.
grace lint and status pass with only the expected lifecycle state.
